how: Opened the public ChatGPT share page and clicked the site's own "Copy response" button under the longest assistant answer (headings, a table and some math).
notes: Copy-button capture. The site writes through navigator.clipboard.write, so there is no org.chromium.source-url. text/plain is the answer as markdown source (pipe tables, ``` fences, $...$ / $$...$$ math, hard line breaks as a trailing backslash); text/html is the app's rendered DOM full of <!--[--> hydration comments, wrapped in <html><head></head><body>, with no inline styles. One pipe table, headings, nested bullet and numbered lists.
